newsitem.title: CHINA: China toilet collapse kills seven students.
newsitem.headline: China toilet collapse kills seven students.

text.p: Seven students were killed and eight injured when a toilet collapsed at their southwestern China school, officials said on Wednesday.
The accident occurred last week at the Shiziwan village primary school in Sichuan province as the students were using the toilet before starting class, a local official said by telephone.
He said the students were aged between 10 and 14. All of the injured were now out of danger, he said.
The collapse was blamed on corroded reinforcement bars in the building housing the toilet.
